description: This file implements cryptography-related classes and functions, including interfaces for cryptography operations, vault management, and cryptographic primitives, with internal classes for RPC-based communication and object management.

classes.name: CryptographyLink
classes.description: Manages RPC connection to cryptography services, providing access to cryptography interfaces and device objects.

classes.name: RPCDiffieHellmanImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IDiffieHellman interface, ensuring thread safety.

classes.name: RPCCipherImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for ICipher interface, ensuring thread safety.

classes.name: RPCRandomImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IRandom interface, ensuring thread safety.

classes.name: RPCHashImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IHash interface, ensuring thread safety.

classes.name: RPCVaultImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for IVault interface, managing vault data and cryptographic operations with thread safety.

classes.name: RPCCryptographyImpl
classes.description: RPC wrapper for ICryptography interface, providing access to cryptographic primitives and vaults with thread safety.

classes.name: RandomImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IRandom using internal random_generate function.

classes.name: HashImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IHash wrapping HashImplementation, managing hash operations.

classes.name: VaultImpl
classes.description: Implementation of IVault and IPersistent, managing vault data and cryptographic key operations.

classes.name: CryptographyImpl
classes.description: Main implementation of ICryptography, providing access to random, hash, vault, and cryptography primitives.

methods.name: Cryptography
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an ICryptography instance, either local or via connection point.

methods.name: VaultId
methods.description: Maps string labels to specific CryptographyVault enum values.
